capabilityHints.summary: A creator launches a WETH-paired token whose exact-input sellers are subsidised toward a transparent, on-chain price floor that only ratchets up, funded by the pool's own trading volume, with no admin, oracle, keeper or upgrade.

components.summary: The one immutable hook bound to the canonical dynamic-fee PoolKey. It binds exactly one pool once at afterInitialize, precommitting the exact launch token, start price and tick spacing so a front-runner cannot capture it with a foreign pool. It accrues the mandatory Programmable volume fee on the executed gross quote-side amount across all four swap quadrants, skims the project slice into a self-funded monotonic price-floor reserve, and on an exact-input sell tops the seller up from that reserve toward the floor after the AMM executes the full swap.

Single-use launcher. One transaction deploys the token, deploys the hook at the mined address, initialises the canonical dynamic-fee pool, seeds one full-range position and settles both currencies; any mismatch reverts the whole transaction.

Fixed-supply ERC-20 minted once in its constructor to the launcher. No owner, minter, pauser, blacklist, transfer tax, rebase, upgrade path or rescue function exists, so the hook's bind-time supply snapshot equals the live supply forever.

project.summary: A single custom v4 hook where every swap skims a project charge (20 bps) into a quote-asset (WETH) reserve that funds a monotonic, ratchet-only price floor; on exact-input sells the hook tops the seller up from the reserve toward the floor AFTER the AMM executes the full swap (the core AMM leg is always the full swap; the hook adds no pricing math of its own), and the mandatory 10 bps Programmable volume fee accrues as an owner-only claimable liability.
project.title: Antifragile Floor
